title: Drawers are WAY to hard to open & close
text: Drawers are WAY to hard to open & close. This product would be ok if the Drawers lined up and they slid easier. But that’s the whole deal actually is to open & shut the drawers. It sits down low so it’s more of a problem when your bent over trying to do this.
